description_en: Queries the details of an egress proxy gateway instance
description_zh: 查询出口代理网关实例详细信息
name: GetEgressProxyGatewayAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the egress proxy gateway instance
parameters.help_zh: 出口代理网关实例的 ID
parameters.name: egress_proxy_gateway_id

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the egress proxy gateway was created. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
CreateTime.description_zh: 出口代理网关的创建时间。采用 UTC 时间，遵循 ISO 8601 标准，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

DefaultEgressProxyIpPoolId.description_en: The ID of the default egress IP pool

Description.description_en: The description of the egress proxy gateway instance. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters and English letters. It can also contain digits, commas (,), periods (.), semicolons (;), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
Description.description_zh: 出口代理网关实例的描述信息。长度限制为 2~256 个字符，支持中文和英文字母，可包含数字、半角逗号（,）、半角句号（.）、半角分号（;）、正斜线（/）、at（@）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

EgressProxyConfigurationId.description_en: The ID of the associated egress proxy configuration

EgressProxyGatewayId.description_en: The ID of the egress proxy gateway instance
EgressProxyGatewayId.description_zh: 出口代理网关实例的 ID

EgressProxyGatewayName.description_en: The name of the egress proxy gateway. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain English letters and Chinese characters. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
EgressProxyGatewayName.description_zh: 出口代理网关名称，长度为 2~128 个英文或中文字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

Port.description_en: The listener port. Valid values: 1 to 65535

Protocol.description_en:
The listener protocol. Valid values:

HTTP
HTTPS
Protocol.description_zh:
监听协议，取值：

HTTP
HTTPS

Status.description_en:
The instance status of the egress proxy gateway. Valid values:

Provisioning: The instance is being created.
Active: The instance is running.
Configuring: The instance is being reconfigured.
Inactive: The instance is stopped
Status.description_zh:
出口代理网关实例状态
Provisioning：创建中
Active：运行中
Configuring：变配中
Inactive：已停止

Key.description_en: The tag key. The key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs: and cannot contain http:// or https://
Key.description_zh: 标签键。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以 aliyun 或 acs:开头，不能包含 http://或 https://

Value.description_en: The tag value. The value can be up to 256 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://
Value.description_zh: 标签值。最多支持256个字符，不能包含http://或https://

PrivateCaCertificateId.description_en: The ID of the private CA certificate

TlsInterceptMode.description_en:
The TLS Block Mode. Valid values:

enable: Enables the TLS Block Mode.
disable: Disables the TLS Block Mode
TlsInterceptMode.description_zh:
TLS 拦截模式，取值：

enable：开启 TLS 拦截模式
disable：关闭 TLS 拦截模式

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC)

ZoneMappings.description_en: The list of zone and vSwitch mappings. If the current region supports two or more zones, at least two zones must be returned
ZoneMappings.description_zh: 可用区及交换机映射列表。若当前地域支持 2 个及以上的可用区，则至少需要返回2 个可用区

items.description_zh: 可用区与交换机映射关系

Status.description_en:
The zone status. Valid values:

Provisioning: The zone is being created.
Available: The zone is available.
Configuring: The zone is being reconfigured
Status.description_zh:
可用区状态：

Provisioning：创建中
Available：可用
Configuring：变配中

VSwitchId.description_en: The ID of the vSwitch that corresponds to the zone
